reference: dstogov/ir 92171d0a4a36b0acf707f2dea7998de615dd4acd ir.h:ir_jit_compile, positive levels above one invoke SCCP before CFG/GCM/matching/liveness/allocation.

validation: 75 independent known-answer executions across public JIT image modes 1, 2 and 3.
Each public object mode produces bytes identical to serializing the corresponding public JIT image.
O1 text matches legacy entry; O2/O3 text matches explicit SCCP followed by the native image entry, byte for byte.
Linked public O3 object passes 25 known-answer executions.

For levels 2 and 3, 128-bit constant payload and red zones agree after both caller and optimized graphs are freed before mapping. Linked AOT payload agrees after object serialization following graph release.
Invalid modes and unsupported O0 rejected by both image/object entry points.
Existing call, vector transport and rejected-rewrite regressions pass.
